analysis.insight_summary: Users express frustration about the absence of an official API or communication support for building custom Android applications that interact with [product_name] modules. The existing mobile app from [company_name] does not meet user needs for advanced customization such as data logging, graphical interfaces, and trending. Recommendations to try third-party apps or middleware have not fully addressed the demand for a documented and supported solution from [company_name].
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [company_name] to provide an official API, a communication library, or clear documentation enabling the development of custom Android apps for [product_name] modules.
